title: Usage store check treats only a git checkout as the checkout
goal: The Claude status line saves its allowance snapshot from any folder that is not a git checkout holding the store
acceptance: Fixture test: `claude-status` from a non-git folder enclosing the store saves; from a git checkout containing the store it is refused
Symlink checks and the `.git` walk up from the store are unchanged
Patch release tagged and published; the record closes on its tag
privacy: Tool text only; fixtures are invented folders; no personal data.
escalation: A change that lets a store inside a git checkout pass is a safety regression; ask first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 at agent speed: one guard in one copied tool, a fixture test and a patch release. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25 (failing-first test committed before the fix); CI, tag and release remain. Closed 2026-11-25.
